name: BVR Waste and Recycling
summary: Roll-off dumpsters for Brenham, College Station, and the Brazos Valley. The areas menu also names Bryan, Navasota, Anderson, and Iola. The residential page lists 14, 20, and 30 yard dumpsters. The commercial page lists 20, 30, and 40 yard dumpsters. No dollar price is published.
accepted: The commercial roll-off FAQ says construction waste such as concrete, asphalt, wood, and scrap metal can go in the roll-off dumpsters. A full allowed list is not published.
prohibited: The commercial roll-off FAQ says hazardous materials like asbestos, batteries, and flammable liquids are not allowed. It says to contact them for a complete list.

offers.fit: Residential page labels a 14-yard dumpster. It says this size holds 6 pickup loads and is ideal for home projects, junk removal, and interior or exterior renovations. The page describes it as a fit for small home clean-up projects.
offers.shortNote: No dollar price is published. The page says it holds 6 pickup loads.
offers.note: Residential roll-off page lists a 14-yard dumpster. The card says it holds 6 pickup loads and is ideal for home projects, junk removal, and interior or exterior renovations. The page describes it as a fit for small home clean-up projects. No dimensions, rental days, included tons, or dollar price are on this page. The commercial FAQ says rental periods run from a few days to several months and does not name one included day count or a dollar price. Homepage addresses: 1555 Highway 36 North, Brenham, TX 77833 and 8825 Stewarts Meadow, College Station, TX 77845.
